g.text: VCC: 5V (Pi) | GND: Common | SDA: GPIO 2 | SCL: GPIO 3 | V+: Ext 5V/6V Power
Ch 15: Main Stage Turntable Base Servo Motor
⚙️ L298N DUAL H-BRIDGE #1 (PARROT 1 - LEFT TALL PARROT)
⚙️ L298N DUAL H-BRIDGE #2 (PARROT 2 - RIGHT TALL PARROT)
🐣 2-CHANNEL RELAY BOARD & SMALL BIRD CHIRP CIRCUITS
⚙️ CENTER SMALL BIRD MOTOR TRANSISTOR / MOSFET DRIVER
GATE / BASE: GPIO 22 (Pin 15) | OUT: Beak & Gearmotor Pulse
• Center Bird: 3-DOF Perch (PCA Ch 12, 13, 14) + Beak Motor (GPIO 22)
• Front Left Bird: Chirp Relay #1 (GPIO 17) + Spotlight + Motor
• Front Right Bird: Chirp Relay #2 (GPIO 27) + Spotlight + Motor
• Rear Left & Rear Right Birds: Spotlights + Movement Motors
Base Rotation Servo Motor: PCA9685 Channel 15
